key.name: density
key.description: How much room rows and items get in the list, grid and columns: “comfortable” as GNOME Files has it, “compact”, “dense” or “extra-dense”. The denser ones also draw the icons one standard size smaller (two in “extra-dense”).

key.name: sidebar-density
key.description: How tall the rows of the sidebar are, apart from the density of the files.

key.name: folder-color-scheme
key.description: The colors that folders given a color are drawn in. Each folder keeps its slot, so changing the scheme recolors every colored folder.

key.name: marks-on-tiles
key.summary: Show ratings and tags on grid tiles
key.description: Draw the stars of rated files and the dots of tagged files on their icons in the grid view.

key.name: columns-stars
key.description: Show the star for starring files on every row in column view, as in the list view.

key.name: window-opacity
key.description: How opaque the window background is, in percent. Below 100 the desktop and other windows show through; with a shell extension that blurs behind windows, they show blurred.

key.name: sidebar-storage-usage
key.description: Show how full each drive in the sidebar's Storage section is, as a thin bar under its name.

key.name: queue-transfers
key.description: When you copy or move while another copy is running, wait for it to finish instead of running both at once.

key.name: progress-popup
key.description: Show copies, moves and other file operations in a panel in the corner of the window while they run.

key.name: ratings
key.description: Offer star ratings in menus, columns, the grid and Quick Look.

key.name: tags
key.description: Offer tags in menus, columns, the grid and Quick Look.

key.name: folder-colors
key.description: Offer folder colors in the context menu and draw colored folders.

key.name: own-quick-look
key.description: Preview with the built-in Quick Look window instead of the external previewer (Sushi).

key.name: quick-look-names
key.summary: Names on the Quick Look canvas
key.description: Show file names under the items when several files are previewed at once.

key.name: quick-look-marks
key.summary: Ratings and tags on the Quick Look canvas
key.description: Show stars and tag dots on the items when several files are previewed at once.

key.name: columns-view
key.description: In the list view, show the folders above the current one as columns on its left, and a selected folder's contents on its right.

key.name: inspector-visible
key.description: Show a panel with a preview and the details of the selected item.

key.name: columns-width
key.summary: Width of the columns in the columns view
key.description: The width in pixels each column starts with. Alt+drag on a column edge sets it for all columns. 0 shares the window width equally between the columns.

key.name: tree-view
key.description: Whether new tabs show the list with expandable folders. The last choice of View is remembered.

key.name: bottom-bar
key.description: Show a bar under each tab with the views, a filter, search and the view menu, instead of search and the view menu in the header bar.

key.name: sidebar-groups
key.description: Show the sidebar as groups that fold away, like File Flier's: Bookmarks, Places, Storage, Recent and Tags.

key.name: sidebar-group-order
key.description: Drag a group's header onto another, or use Move Up and Move Down in its menu.

key.name: sidebar-colors
key.description: Icon color slot (0-7, in the folder color scheme) of sidebar rows, by row: its uri, "group:ID" for a group header or "name:LABEL".

key.name: sidebar-hidden-places
key.description: Rows of the Places section not shown: home, recent, starred, downloads, documents, pictures, videos, music, network, trash. A bookmark for a folder shown here is left out of Bookmarks.

key.name: sidebar-hidden-groups
key.description: Sidebar groups not shown at all: bookmarks, places, cloud, devices, recent, tags.

key.name: sidebar-collapsed
key.description: The sidebar groups that are folded away.

key.name: menu-shortcuts
key.description: Show the keys next to the items of the bottom bar's menus, to learn them.

key.name: run-in-background
key.description: Keep running after the last window closes, so new windows open at once.

key.name: shortcut-hints
key.description: Briefly show what a keyboard shortcut did, at the bottom of the window.

key.name: inspector-side
key.description: Which side of the window the inspector is docked to.

key.name: inspector-size
key.description: The width (or height, at the bottom) of the inspector in pixels.

key.name: custom-shortcuts
key.description: Actions whose shortcuts were changed in the shortcuts overview (F1), with their keys. Actions not listed use their defaults.

key.name: file-flier-imported
key.description: Whether the folder colors and tags of File Flier were brought over once.
